# Tuteliq Swift SDK

> Official Swift SDK for Tuteliq — AI-powered child safety API for iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS.

## What is this?
A Swift package for the Tuteliq child safety API. Detect bullying, grooming, self-harm, fraud, radicalisation, and other harms in text, conversations, voice, images, video, and PDF documents; detect AI-generated content; and run hosted age and identity verification. Works with iOS 15+, macOS 12+, tvOS 15+, watchOS 8+, and visionOS 1+.

## Install
// Package.swift
.package(url: "https://github.com/Tuteliq/swift.git", from: "3.0.0")

## Quick Start
import Tuteliq
let client = try Tuteliq(apiKey: apiKey)
let result = try await client.detectUnsafe(content: "content to check", context: AnalysisContext(ageGroup: "13-15"))
if result.recommendedAction.isActionable { /* flag_for_review or stronger */ }

## Key Features
- Swift concurrency (async/await), Codable models, no dependencies
- Branch on `recommendedAction` (none, monitor, flagForReview, block, immediateIntervention)
- Multi-turn risk: continuation tokens, `trajectoryRisk`, `context.priorMessages`
- Safety: detectBullying, detectGrooming, detectUnsafe, analyze, analyzeEmotions
- Fraud and extended harms: social engineering, app fraud, romance scams, mule recruitment, gambling harm, coercive control, vulnerability exploitation, radicalisation, distress signals, TFGBV, analyseMulti
- Media: analyzeVoice, analyzeImage, analyzeVideo, analyzeDocument (PDF), real-time voiceStream
- Synthetic content: detectSyntheticText/Image/Audio/Video
- Verification: createVerificationSession / getVerificationSession (age and identity verification; Pro+ / Business+)
- Session API for your own capture UI: VerificationSessionCredentials (session link: https on verify.tuteliq.ai only; uploads go to https://api.tuteliq.ai unless apiBaseURL is passed), VerificationSessionClient (mode, progress, startLiveness, validate-document, validate-chip, validate-selfie, submit), LivenessTokenBuilder, SessionSubmission
- capture_context (CaptureContext) is untrusted device metadata: SDK, OS version and device model, cameras and on-device engines, derived verdicts and pass rates. No images and no raw facial measurements are sent.
- Native iOS verification (document capture, NFC chip reading, liveness, selfie) is a separate, licensed package: Tuteliq Verification
- Platform: webhooks, policy and automation rules, detection settings, threat intelligence, incidents dashboard, moderator review, audit receipts, customer-managed encryption keys, GDPR and breach management
- Crisis helplines localised via `context.country` and `supportThreshold`
- Keychain-backed API key storage

## Supported Languages
27 languages: English (stable), Spanish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Italian, Turkish, Romanian, Greek, Czech, Hungarian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Slovenian, Maltese, Irish (beta). Auto-detected, no configuration needed.
